title: EXP-07 C10 Claim-by-Claim Adversarial Audit Register

audit_table.claim_text: Protocol-identical replicate executed with zero protocol drift.
audit_table.evidence: Programmatic diff shows 17 configuration blocks identical. train_exp07.py parameters match 100%. exp07_reference.py was unchanged.
Instantiated ResNet18UNet and both best checkpoints strictly contain 14,310,860 trainable parameters and 14,322,666 total state elements.

audit_table.claim_text: Two-seed comparison between Seed 42 and Seed 101 is bitwise-verified.
audit_table.evidence: Independent evaluation of checkpoints matched recorded metrics bitwise (0.0e+00 diff), but Seed 42 and Seed 101 are different stochastic runs (0.119 vs 0.138), not bitwise identical to each other.
audit_table.correction_required: Clarify that bitwise verification applies to checkpoint metric recomputation, not cross-seed comparison.

audit_table.claim_text: Rare-class zero IoU proves structural impossibility.
audit_table.evidence: Two seeds demonstrate empirical failure recurrence under this protocol, but cannot prove universal structural impossibility without controlled interventional experiments.
audit_table.correction_required: Downgrade from 'PROVEN / CONFIRMED' to 'OBSERVED RECURRENCE / SUPPORTED HYPOTHESIS'.

audit_table.claim_text: BS and LWA exhibit reciprocal label swapping due to acoustic similarity.
audit_table.evidence: Confusion matrix audit proves that 63.75% of BS pixels were misclassified as Eddy in Seed 101 (not LWA). LWA true positives stayed steady while precision rose because Eddy absorbed BS false positives. Modality is radar, not acoustic.
audit_table.correction_required: Replace with empirical confusion matrix finding: Eddy cannibalized BS pixels, cleaning up LWA false positives.

audit_table.claim_text: 4-stage UNet pooling causes HM point-target failure (CONFIRMED).
audit_table.evidence: HM is 0.021% of TRAIN pixels (985 pixels). Receptive field downsampling is a plausible factor, but has not been isolated via architectural ablation.

audit_table.claim_text: Parent Scene 01 failure is confirmed sensor domain shift.
audit_table.evidence: Scene 01 exhibits severe prediction collapse of MCC and POW into BG and WS in both seeds, but sensor calibration / physical drift was not measured.
audit_table.correction_required: Reclassify from 'CONFIRMED SENSOR DOMAIN SHIFT' to 'REPRODUCIBLE PARENT-SPECIFIC REPRESENTATION COLLAPSE'.
